def sos_pieces(ctx, N):
    N=sp.sympify(N)
    L=setup.L
    astar=setup.f.grad(ctx['x_star'])
    pieces=[]
    for i in range(1,int(N)+1):
        xprev,x=ctx[f'x_{i-1}'],ctx[f'x_{i}']
        aprev,a=setup.f.grad(xprev),setup.f.grad(x)
        s=setup.g.grad(x)
        c1=N/((2*N+1-i)*(2*N-i)*L)
        u1=sp.Rational(i,2)/N*a+(2*N-i)/(2*N)*aprev-astar
        c2=(sp.Integer(i-1)/(2*N-i)*(2*N+2)/(2*N+1)+2*N/((2*N-i)**2*(2*N+1)))/(2*L)
        u2=aprev+s-L/(2*N+1-i)*(xprev-ctx['x_star'])
        c3=sp.Integer(i)/(2*N+1-i)*2*N/(2*N+1)/(2*L)
        u3=(2*N+1)/(2*N)*(a+s)-(aprev+s)/(2*N)-L/(2*N-i)*(x-ctx['x_star'])
        pieces.extend([(i,'u1',c1,u1),(i,'u2',c2,u2),(i,'u3',c3,u3)])
    return pieces

def inventory(ctx, pb):
    entries = [(c, 'initial', None, None) for c in pb.init_conditions]
    for owner in ctx.func_to_triplets:
        groups = ctx.get_constraint_data(owner)
        entries.extend((c, 'interpolation', str(owner), str(group))
                       for group, constraints in groups.sc_dict.items() for c in constraints)
        entries.extend((c, 'interpolation', str(owner), str(group)) for group, c in groups.psd_dict.items())
    return entries

def residual_of(c):
    residual = c.lhs-c.rhs
    return -residual if c.cmp in (Comparator.GE,Comparator.SEQ) else residual

def verify(data, dense_value, decomposition=None):
    ctx,pb,_ = setup.get_pep_setup(data['N'],json.loads(data['params_json']))
    if data['relaxed_constraints']:
        pb.set_relaxed_constraints(data['relaxed_constraints'])
    for func in ctx.func_to_triplets:
        func.get_interpolation_constraints(ctx)
    entries = inventory(ctx,pb)
    assert set(data['constraint_metadata']) == {c.name for c,*_ in entries}
    assert data['basis_vectors'] == [str(v) for v in ctx.basis_vectors()]
    assert data['basis_scalars'] == [str(v) for v in ctx.basis_scalars()]
    pm = pf.ExpressionManager(ctx,resolve_parameters={'L':sp.S.One,'R':sp.S.One})
    weighted=pf.Scalar.zero()
    vals=[]
    for c,*_ in entries:
        value=data['named_dual_values'][c.name]
        if c.name in pb.relaxed_constraints:
            assert value is None
            continue
        assert isinstance(c,pf.ScalarConstraint), 'This PGM sample has only scalar constraints'
        weighted += float(value)*(pf.Scalar.zero()+residual_of(c))
        if c.cmp != Comparator.EQ:
            vals.append(float(value))
    basis=ctx.basis_vectors()
    S=np.asarray(data['S_matrix'],dtype=float)
    S_scalar=sum((float(S[i,j])*basis[i]*basis[j] for i,j in np.ndindex(S.shape)),pf.Scalar.zero())
    checked=pm.eval_scalar(pb.performance_metric-data['opt_value']-weighted+S_scalar)
    def ma(v):
        return float(np.max(np.abs(np.asarray(v,dtype=float)),initial=0.0))
    reconstruction=S if decomposition is None else np.asarray(decomposition['ell_coords']).T@np.asarray(decomposition['D'])@np.asarray(decomposition['ell_coords'])
    residuals=dict(identity_gram_max_abs=ma(checked.inner_prod_coords),identity_func_max_abs=ma(checked.func_coords),identity_offset_abs=ma(checked.offset),
                   S_reconstruction_max_abs=ma(reconstruction-S),dense_relaxed_gap=abs(data['opt_value']-dense_value),
                   minimum_scalar_inequality_dual=min(vals,default=0.0),minimum_S_eigenvalue=float(np.linalg.eigvalsh((S+S.T)/2).min()),
                   minimum_matrix_inequality_eigenvalue=0.0,candidate_rate_gap=abs(data['opt_value']-1/(4*data['N'])))
    passed=data['certificate_provenance']['solver_status']=='optimal' and np.all(np.isfinite(S)) and np.allclose(S,S.T,atol=1e-6,rtol=0)
    passed=passed and all(residuals[k]<=1e-5 for k in ('identity_gram_max_abs','identity_func_max_abs','identity_offset_abs','dense_relaxed_gap','candidate_rate_gap'))
    passed=passed and np.allclose(reconstruction,S,atol=1e-4,rtol=1e-5) and residuals['minimum_scalar_inequality_dual']>=-1e-6 and residuals['minimum_S_eigenvalue']>=-1e-6
    return dict(tolerances=TOL,residuals=residuals,passed=bool(passed)),ctx,pb,checked
